question.text: The total number of 4 -digit numbers in which the digits are in descending order, is

solution.text:
Total number of arrangements of 10 digits $0,1,2, \ldots, 9$ bytaking 4 at atime $={ }^{10} \mathrm{C}_{4} \times 4 !$

We observe that in every arrangement of 4 selected digits there is just one arrangement in which the digits are in descending order.

$\therefore$ Required number of 4 -digit numbers.

$$

=\frac{{ }^{10} \mathrm{C}_{4} \times 4 !}{4 !}={ }^{10} \mathrm{C}_{4}

$$
